content: I need a box, that is on the upside open. The outer dimensions are 220 x 300 x 160mm. The wall thickness should be 8mm and the bottom thickness 12mm | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate inner dimensions of the box\\nouter_x = 220\\nouter_y = 300\\nouter_z = 160\\nwall_thickness = 8\\nbottom_thickness = 12\\n\\n# Inner dimensions\\ninner_x = outer_x - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_y = outer_y - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_z = outer_z - bottom_thickness\\n\\n# Base points for the outer and inner boxes\\nouter_box_x = 0\\nouter_box_y = 0\\nouter_box_z = 0\\n\\ninner_box_x = wall_thickness\\ninner_box_y = wall_thickness\\ninner_box_z = bottom_thickness\\n\\n# Return the calculated values\\n{\\n    \\\"outer_x\\\": outer_x, \\\"outer_y\\\": outer_y, \\\"outer_z\\\": outer_z,\\n    \\\"inner_x\\\": inner_x, \\\"inner_y\\\": inner_y, \\\"inner_z\\\": inner_z,\\n    \\\"outer_box_x\\\": outer_box_x, \\\"outer_box_y\\\": outer_box_y, \\\"outer_box_z\\\": outer_box_z,\\n    \\\"inner_box_x\\\": inner_box_x, \\\"inner_box_y\\\": inner_box_y, \\\"inner_box_z\\\": inner_box_z\\n}\"}"
